vetSays.line: 🛡️ Seymour, Michelle, Esmeralda and Intisar met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off. Seymour, Michelle, Intisar are hurt.
🛡️ Seymour, Michelle and Intisar met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off. Michelle, Intisar are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Chloe just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Seymour just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Seymour, Esmeralda and Intisar met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Seymour, Intisar are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Intisar just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
